notes:
Prices page: the 🎯 and 🔍 buttons are now one "⚠ Wrong price?" button. It lists every price on the page, marks a best guess, and still lets you point and click on the page.
Pages that hide a $0.01 / $1.00 stand-in price in their code are now handled: the app reloads the page, waits for the real price to appear and reads that. If it can't tell, it flags the store instead of saving the fake price.
